decline:
Dear {{ preprint.owner.full_name }},

Unfortunately we have decided not to publish your {{ request.repository.object_name }}.

The moderator provided the following note:

{{preprint.preprint_decline_note}}

Regards,

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
publication:
Dear {{ preprint.owner.full_name }},

Your preprint has been published on {{ request.repository.name }}. It is now available on our website.

Regards,

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
submission:
Dear {{ preprint.owner.full_name }},

Thank you for your {{ request.repository.object_name }} submission titled {{ preprint.title }}. An Editor will review it before making a decision.

Regards,

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
accept_version:
Dear {{ pending_update.preprint.owner.full_name }},

Thank you for uploading a new version of {{ pending_update.preprint.title }}. This has been approved and is now live.

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
decline_version:
Dear {{ pending_update.preprint.owner.full_name }},

Thank you for uploading a new version of {{ pending_update.preprint.title }}. This update has been declined, the reason is provided below.

{{ reason|safe }}

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
new_comment:
Dear {{ manager.full_name }},

A new comment has been submitted on {{ preprint.title }} and is awaiting moderation. Review the comment in the moderation queue.

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
comment_published:
Dear {{ preprint.owner.full_name }},

A comment on your submission {{ preprint.title }} has been approved and is now publicly visible. View the comment on the submission page.

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
comment_approved:
Dear {{ comment.author.full_name }},

Your comment on {{ preprint.title }} has been approved and is now publicly visible. View your approved comment.

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
review_invitation:
Dear {{ review.reviewer.full_name }},

I hope this message finds you well. We would like to invite you to comment on a {{ request.repository.object_name }} titled {{ review.preprint.title }} submitted to {{ request.repository.name }}. We would be most grateful for your time and feedback.

{{ url }}

{{ request.user.signature }}
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
review_helper: Add your comments below. These will be displayed publicly once approved. You can mark your comments as anonymous if you do not want to display your name alongside the comments.
manager_review_status_change:
Dear {{ review.manager.full_name }},

The Review invitation you initiated for "{{ review.preprint.title }}" has been updated.

{{ status_text }}

You can view the review here: {{url}}

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
reviewer_review_status_change:
Dear {{ review.reviewer.full_name }},

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you that the invitation we sent to ask that you add a review comment to "{{ review.preprint.title }}" has been withdrawn. The following reason has been given:

{{ review.status_reason|linebreaksbr }}

{{ request.user.signature|safe }}
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
new_version_submitted:
{{ preprint.owner.full_name }} has uploaded a new version of the {{ request.repository.object_name }} '{{ preprint.title }}' to {{ request.repository.name }}.

The new version can be viewed in the queue: {{ url }}.

{{ request.repository.name }} Team
{{ request.repository.site_url }}
copy_request_to_author:
Dear {{ copy_request.asked_name|default:"author" }},

{{ copy_request.name }} ({{ copy_request.email }}) has asked for a copy of your accepted manuscript of {{ preprint.title|striptags }} in {{ repository.name }}, which is {{ copy_request.file.access_label|lower }}.

They said: {{ copy_request.reason|linebreaksbr }}

To send them a copy, or to decline, go to:
{{ decide_url }}

If you agree, they'll get a download link that works for 7 days. Your email address isn't passed on. If you don't answer within 30 days, the request expires.

{{ repository.name }}
copy_request_approved:
Dear {{ copy_request.name }},

The author has agreed to send you a copy of {{ preprint.title|striptags }} for your own use. You can download it until {{ copy_request.download_until|date:"j F Y" }}:
{{ download_url }}

{{ repository.name }}
copy_request_declined:
Dear {{ copy_request.name }},

We're sorry: a copy of {{ preprint.title|striptags }} can't be sent to you at the moment.{% if copy_request.file.embargo_until %} It will be openly available from {{ copy_request.file.embargo_until|date:"j F Y" }}.{% endif %}

{{ repository.name }}
copy_request_expired:
Dear {{ copy_request.name }},

We're sorry: the author hasn't answered your request for a copy of {{ preprint.title|striptags }}, so it has expired.{% if copy_request.file.embargo_until %} It will be openly available from {{ copy_request.file.embargo_until|date:"j F Y" }}.{% endif %}

{{ repository.name }}
